programs.name: MassHousing Down Payment Assistance, Option 1 (deferred)
programs.repayment: interest-free deferred second mortgage; the entire balance is due when the home is sold or refinanced, or the first mortgage is paid off
programs.firstTimeNote: income-eligible first-time homebuyer; the approved lender determines the option and amount
programs.quote: Option 1 is an interest-free deferred payment second mortgage loan, meaning no payments are due until the property is sold or refinanced, or the first mortgage loan is paid off

programs.name: MassHousing Down Payment Assistance, Option 2 (2%, 15 years)
programs.repayment: 15-year amortizing second mortgage at a fixed 2% (APR 2%); MassHousing's example: $25,000 = 180 payments of $160.88
programs.quote: A DPA loan in the amount of $25,000 would have 180 payments of $160.88

programs.name: MassHousing Down Payment Assistance, Option 3 (3%, 15 years)
programs.repayment: 15-year amortizing second mortgage at a fixed 3% (APR 3%); MassHousing's example: $25,000 = 180 payments of $172.62
programs.quote: A DPA loan in the amount of $25,000 would have 180 payments of $172.62
